toxicities: 与酒精或阿片等抑制剂混用可能致命。
summary: 一种非常常见且广泛处方的苯二氮卓，具有催眠和镇静作用，是其他苯二氮卓的衡量基准。过量可导致失忆和抑制解除。与其他苯二氮卓相比半衰期较长。
effectsSummary: Diazepam has a calming, relaxing, antispasmodic, anti-anxiety and sleep-inducing effect. Taking benzodiazepines increases the effectiveness of the neurotransmitter GABA.
generalRisks: There is little information available on risks, toxicity, side effects and long-term consequences. When mixing with other downers (alcohol, opioids, etc.) there is a risk of respiratory depression.
longtermRisks: Regular and long-term use can lead to psychological and physical dependence. Immediate discontinuation after prolonged use can lead to negative withdrawal symptoms including anxiety, insomnia, and seizures.
saferUse: 如果在黑市或网上购买药物而非从药房/医疗机构获取，实际成分可能与标识不同。
